message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the parquet data, CSV folds, or loaded images at any point in the data acquisition path.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read directly from local filesystem paths (parquet files, CSV) with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authentication of any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data preparation code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a pretrained EfficientNet model via 'pretrained': True and loads EMA checkpoints with torch.load(), but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity of the loaded weights.

No detected label distribution validation: The code uses a blacklist to remove known bad samples but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous-sample detection on the training labels before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard AdamW optimization with AMP and EMA but has no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any other differential privacy mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are referenced anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Validation data is split by fold index with no cryptographic hashing or signing of evaluation data, and only a single metric (hierarchical_recall) is monitored, with no isolated held-out test set enforced programmatically.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path (get_test_data_generator, BengaliAiDataset) loads and processes raw parquet image data without any shape/range validation, schema checks, or malformed-input rejection.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the visible inference path checks model output probabilities for NaN, out-of-range values, or calibration thresholds before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision/classification model (Bengali handwriting recognition), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
